result.summary: Adds an `IWYU pragma: always_keep` directive to `bitcoin-build-config.h.in` and strips the now-redundant `// IWYU pragma: keep` inline comments from all files that include it. The C++ linter is also updated to expect clean include directives without the comment.
result.problem: Every file including `bitcoin-build-config.h` previously required an inline `// IWYU pragma: keep` comment to prevent Include-What-You-Use tooling from stripping the header. This added noise to include sections and made searching for genuine, one-off keep pragmas across the codebase difficult.
evidence: PR description: "grepping for `IWYU pragma: keep` returns only the genuine use cases, each of which should be properly documented."
result.scope_notes: A scripted-diff changing 65 files with mechanical replacements across includes.
result.card: Marks bitcoin-build-config.h with IWYU pragma: always_keep and removes redundant per-include keep pragmas across the codebase via scripted-diff. Previously, every file including the build config header required an inline pragma comment to prevent Include-What-You-Use tooling from removing it, adding boilerplate and cluttering searches for genuine pragmas. The C++ linter is also updated to check for clean include statements.

risk.why: The changes only affect code comments and linter regexes, with no impact on compiled binary output or runtime behaviour.
